title: Anthropic’s Fable 5.1 boosts speed and cuts costs sharply #shorts #anthropic #fable5
description: Anthropic’s release of Fable 5.1 addresses key limitations in Claude’s previous versions, notably fixing Claude’s peak problem to produce more natural, human-like responses. Fable 5.1 delivers twice the speed and uses half the tokens of its predecessor Opus 5 while achieving superior results across benchmarks, especially excelling in agentic scientific research with scores more than double those of Fable 5. It also reduces operational costs by 25-45%, enhancing efficiency for diverse applications. This upgrade significantly expands Claude’s practical use cases, demonstrated by impressive feats such as one-shotting Mario Kart, generating detailed Minecraft worlds, and transforming a single property photo into a fully designed, rendered house with a cinematic walkthrough. These improvements make Fable 5.1 a powerful tool for researchers, developers, creators, and general users seeking advanced AI capabilities with greater realism and efficiency. #Anthropic #Fable5 #ClaudeAI #AIresearch #ArtificialIntelligence #AIspeed #AgenticAI #AIcostefficiency #AIbenchmarks #AIdesign
